text:
alex: Hey folks, I'm drafting a small section for audit log retention and a migration checklist for our docs PR. Need SOC2-friendly wording and short SDK + curl examples.

maria: Where will this live? under docs/security or sdk guides?

alex: Main copy under docs/security/audit-logs.md and a condensed snippet in SDK reference pages.
dave: For compliance text, I usually write: 'Default retention is 90 days. Extended retention options are available via contract.' Keep it factual.

jen: Add data-minimization line: 'Only required audit metadata (request id, timestamp, actor) is retained by default; request/response bodies are redacted unless customers opt in.'

samira: Legal: avoid promising explicit retention periods unless product defaults exist. Use 'default' language and note contractual exceptions.

alex: Draft sentence: 'Default retention: 90 days. Extended retention may be provisioned under contract and subject to regulatory constraints.' Good?
maria: Fine. Also add a small migration checklist: export legacy logs, validate schema, re-ingest into new export pipeline.
alex: Draft curl snippet for export API — please verify syntax:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/exports" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"from":"2024-01-01","to":"2024-03-31","redact":true}'
```

dave: Note: redact=true strips payload fields matching sensitive schemas; timestamps and ids are retained. Add examples like PII and auth tokens.

jen: SDK python example suggestion:
```python
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
client.create_export(from_date="2024-01-01", to_date="2024-03-31", redact=True)
```

samira: Also include compliance-friendly export handling note: 'Exports are provisioned for a limited time and encrypted. For long-term archival, customers should use their own storage or request a dedicated arrangement.'

alex: Good, I'll link Key Management page instead of duplicating details.
maria: Add a line that extended retention requests route to sales/contracting.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1456 (labels: docs, compliance)

dave: Quick read LGTM. left a comment about listing what counts as 'sensitive schemas'.

jen: I'll add a short bulleted list in the docs: PII, auth tokens, full request bodies.

samira: Legal approves the wording pending routing to contracts.

alex: Thanks — will update PR, resolve comments, and merge after docs CI. Ping me for a final tone pass. :thumbsup:
